slot.brief: Provide the structure of a branched compound with a functional group and multiple identical substituents; ask for the correct IUPAC name including lowest-locant rules.

stem: What is the correct IUPAC name of $\text{CH}_3-\text{CH(OH)}-\text{CH}_2-\text{C}(\text{CH}_3)_2-\text{CH}_3$?

verdicts.working: The longest chain containing the OH group has five carbons. Numbering from the end nearest the OH gives it position 2, with methyl groups at 4,4.

working:
Longest chain containing $-\text{OH}$: five carbons.
Number from the end nearer $-\text{OH}$: $\text{OH}$ at C-2.
Two methyl substituents are at C-4.
Name: 4,4-dimethylpentan-2-ol.

Independent check: The longest chain containing the OH group has five carbons. Numbering from the end nearest the OH gives it position 2, with methyl groups at 4,4.
solution:
The longest chain containing the $-\text{OH}$ group has five carbons. Number from the end nearest the $-\text{OH}$ group: it is at C-2, and the two methyl groups are at C-4.
$$\boxed{\text{4,4-dimethylpentan-2-ol}}$$
